hypothesis_h6_evaluation.decision_summary: Hypothesis H6 is QUALIFIED. Explanations exhibit measurable, statistically significant distribution shifts between the clean validation period and the blind stress window: Feature rank Spearman rho = 0.993 (p = 6.1599e-22), adaptive dynamic graph reliance shifted by +1.2% (t = -0.97, p = 3.3377e-01), and temporal recency ratio shifted from 10.029 to 11.081.

methodological_caveats: Model attribution quantifies internal sensitivity, not real-world economic causality.
Evaluations were performed on a frozen model without tuning on the blind stress set.
Stress window represents one specific market period (Nov 2024 - Jan 2025) and does not imply universal stress robustness.
